description: This file contains extension functions for converting a list of CreateShareResponse objects into OCShare objects, used in the context of sharing files or folders in the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: toOCShareList
methods.description: Converts a list of CreateShareResponse objects into a list of OCShare objects, filtering out responses with id -1.

methods.name: toOCShare
methods.description: Converts a single CreateShareResponse object into an OCShare object, mapping various properties accordingly.
